verdict.rationale: FFmpeg ships official, vendor-maintained C libraries (libavformat, libavfilter, libavdevice) with coding examples and per-release versioned Doxygen documentation (9.0, 8.1, 8.0…). That covers one mainstream language only. Community reports say the libav API documentation and tutorials are thin or outdated, which lowers quality but does not contradict that the libraries exist. Missing for 10: official bindings or client libraries for other mainstream languages (Python, JS, Java, Go, etc.), and clear, current API documentation and examples.
